text.card: A red giant 4,060 parsecs away, 19 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 2.78 solar masses and 18.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,087 K at its surface.
